raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. raw_region_map gives an unambiguous one-to-one mapping from code to name (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so silver_customers can translate the codes and leave existing names as they are.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
